Third-party code in this folder

mp4-h264.js, mp4-h264.wasm.js
  mp4-h264 1.0.7 by Matt DesLauriers, https://github.com/mattdesl/mp4-h264 (MIT, below).
  Compiled from minih264 (https://github.com/lieff/minih264) and minimp4 (https://github.com/lieff/minimp4) by lieff,
  both dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0.
  Local changes: converted from an ES module to a classic script; createNamedFunction and the embind
  invoker use closures instead of new Function, so the page's CSP needs no 'unsafe-eval'.
